new.statement: Young games selling a game pass priced above 349 Robux rank lower on Up-and-Coming among games of the same age
Long-running hits stage one signature moment with heavy visual effects (egg-hatch reveal, ultimate ability, runway podium) while keeping the rest of the screen simple
new.rationale: Video observations for Adopt Me!, The Strongest Battlegrounds, Dress To Impress and BedWars all show one heavily staged payoff, while Brookhaven and Adopt Me! keep the HUD almost empty; Blox Fruits is the counter-example with a dense HUD. More long-running hits with video labels, and a vid_* feature for staged reveals, would confirm it.

qualitative_updates.note: Day 3 of support: 'Steal' titles now go with much weaker Top Trending standing (r -0.75), steal loops have low medians on Top Earning (31) and Up-and-Coming (28), Steal A Verity! is among the weakest on Most Popular, and Steal an Clown Egg is among the weakest Top Trending games, while the original Steal An Egg still leads Most Popular.
Cross-chart entries again run tt->mp (52, median 2 days) and uc->tt (49, median 2 days) as the two largest flows, ahead of uc->mp (30) and te-> moves.

Sell Fries! [Anomaly] is #2 on Up-and-Coming but among the weakest Top Earning games; Home Alone: Anomalies slipped 4 on Top Trending. The genre keeps reach without revenue; Halloween season remains a confounder.
Mixed: Young Street, Ontario RP rose on Top Earning and racing_driving loops keep a good Top Earning median (65), but Scooter Empire is now the weakest game on Most Popular.
